editorial:
Imagine being a cop who is just totally done with the job. That is where you meet the main character, played by Mimi Rogers. She gets moved to a boring desk job taking photos of evidence, which seems like a way to just coast until retirement. But things get messy fast when she starts a secret romance with a married man. The vibe is a mix of a moody crime show and a romantic drama, making you feel the tension as she balances her private life with a scary new murder case.

You will love how the mystery slowly builds up, though some parts of the plot feel a bit slow. Mimi Rogers does a great job showing her confusion and fear as the clues start pointing toward the man she loves. It is a solid pick if you enjoy old-school TV thrillers with a big twist.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the evidence proves her lover is actually the killer. He tried to play the victim, but her photography skills caught the details he missed. In the final scenes, she has to choose between her feelings and her badge. She ultimately takes him down, ending the killing spree. It wraps up with her finding her strength again as a cop, though the romance ends in a total disaster.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s crime mysteries and romantic thrillers.
